==Summary== {{Information |attention= |description=*[[Sifo-Dyas]]' [[Case file 127456|case file]]. *[[Aurebesh]] [[Wikipedia:Transliteration|transliteration]]: 
Case file 127456

Jedi Master
Sifo Dias [sic]

Jedi Master Sifo Dias [sic] died
while trying to negotiate
a peace between tribes on
Felucia. He was aboard
Jedi T6 shuttle 77519
when it crashed. Much of
the
information surrounding his
death remains confidential
under the Office of the
Chancellor.

It is believed that his body was even-
tually removed and cremated by the
Felucian tribes
in accordance with their customs. For
this reason there has been limited evi-
dence
which confirms the exact location [sic] his
disappearance. Further inspection in
the
matter may be authorized at a future date.

Previous History

Served as a peace negotiator with the
Pike [sic] Syndicates under Chancelor [sic]
|source={{TCW|The Lost One}} |artist= |filespecs= |licensing={{TV-screenshot}} |other versions= |cat artist= |cat licensee=[[Category:Images from The Lost One]] |cat subject=[[Category:Images of Aurebesh]] [[Category:Images of Felucia]] [[Category:Images of holograms]] [[Category:Images of lightsaber hilts]] [[Category:Images of Sifo-Dyas]] [[Category:Images of T-6 shuttles]] |cat type=[[Category:3D CGI animation images]] }}
